scoring_justification: Barriers can be recomputed from the agent's raw NEB energy profile (neb_profiles.csv); this is T1.

outputs.description: Raw NEB energy profile: for each charge state (V_As^+, V_As^-), each image along the path has an energy in eV.
The extracted migration barriers for the two charge states.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute barriers from neb_profiles.csv and compare them to the hidden gold values with tolerance. The migration_barriers.json is also verified for consistency with the CSV-derived barriers.

steps.description: Recompute migration barriers from the NEB energy profile and compare to paper gold. Structural checks: minimum number of images per charge state and variation.
Verify the reported migration barriers match the hidden gold values within tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold migration barriers for V_As^+ and V_As^-
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 6 and main text: reported E_m(V_As^+)=1.93 eV, E_m(V_As^-)=1.91 eV for ZB GaAs.
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper's reported values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers the paper claims; used as reference after recomputing from the agent's raw NEB profile.
